context: All 78 meanings remain task-local candidates; this part selects exact source and corresponding individual Definition/v1 review records.
goal: Prepare exact individual candidate Definition records and meanings for semantic review.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: The challenge is not a validated hiring selection procedure.
A challenge release does not itself authorize participant data collection.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One MVP challenge release and eligible audience.
working_meaning.statement: A Developer Challenge is the participant-facing, versioned offer of practice, up to three scored case sessions and purpose-limited provisional feedback under one declared administration and data-use protocol.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: An invitation is not research permission.
Redeeming an invitation does not prove eligibility or complete enrollment.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One recruitment event and participant entry route.
working_meaning.statement: An Invitation is a one-use, versioned offer to an eligible person to enter a specified Challenge and Study Protocol, recording source channel and redemption state without assigning a score.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A mixed-developer formative protocol is not role-specific hiring validation.
A draft protocol has no participant-collection authority.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One formative pilot or named-role validation study.
working_meaning.statement: A Study Protocol is a versioned prospective plan fixing population, eligibility, purposes, procedures, measures, assignment, exclusions, analysis, stopping rules, custody and decision owners before a pilot or study collects data.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A user-interface choice alone does not determine the lawful basis for processing.
Challenge access does not imply optional research, follow-up, training or employer sharing.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One participant, purpose and notice version.
working_meaning.statement: A Purpose Choice is one attributable participant action about one named processing purpose under an exact notice version, with time, source and later withdrawal or supersession recorded.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: An attempt is not one Session or one Response.
A retry must preserve its predecessor and reason rather than replace history.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One challenge participation; practice is separate.
working_meaning.statement: An Assessment Attempt is one participant's version-pinned scored journey under a Study Protocol, containing at most three ordered Session slots and a terminal completion, withdrawal or void state.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Allocation cannot be changed after observing an answer without a recorded deviation.
A manifest does not prove case forms are equivalent.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One Study Protocol version and its allocations.
working_meaning.statement: An Assignment Manifest is a frozen allocation rule and result set binding eligible attempts to case versions, order, arms and response modes with recorded probabilities, strata and randomization provenance.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Assignment is not evidence that the participant viewed or answered the case.
A retired case may remain pinned to historical answers but cannot receive new assignments.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One scored slot and one administration instance.
working_meaning.statement: A Session Assignment is one immutable binding of an Attempt slot to a released Case Version, Rubric, Response Mode and Administration Policy, with any retry linked to its voided predecessor.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A browser timer does not establish compliance with the recorded-time rule.
An accommodation route is not a scoring penalty.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One Challenge and compatible Study Protocol version.
working_meaning.statement: An Administration Policy is a versioned rule set for case reveal, recorded-time cap, allowed help, pause, retry, device failure and accessible modes applied consistently to a declared population and case set.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: An event log is not the answer recording.
Client timestamps are diagnostic and cannot silently override server order.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One session state or reveal occurrence.
working_meaning.statement: A Session Event is an append-only, server-timed observation or accepted transition in one Session, with sequence, actor, purpose and causal parent sufficient to replay delivery and failure history.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: An upload receipt does not establish the answer's meaning or validity.
Media custody does not grant scorer, research or public access.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One committed source recording version.
working_meaning.statement: A Media Object is a private, content-digested and duration-verified source recording or chunk set bound to one Session Assignment, capture mode, custody location and retention class.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: The ASR output is not the source Response.
A successful job does not imply words or reasoning evidence were transcribed correctly.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One transcription job and source media version.
working_meaning.statement: An ASR Run is a version-pinned speech-to-text processing attempt on one Media Object, retaining engine/configuration, status, uncertainty and output Transcript reference or failure.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Correction never rewrites the original Media Object.
Corrected text cannot be treated as an independently recorded spoken answer.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One transcript successor version.
working_meaning.statement: A Transcript Correction is an attributable, versioned change proposed or confirmed by a participant or authorized reviewer against one Transcript, preserving the prior text, source alignment and reason.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A span is supporting material, not a rating or proof of construct validity.
A text excerpt must remain traceable to the source and its transcription uncertainty.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One rating claim about one answer version.
working_meaning.statement: An Answer Evidence Span is a source-linked excerpt or time interval in one Response or Transcript cited for a specific Criterion Rating, with version, location and correction status.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Adjudication does not erase rater disagreement.
A resolved rating is not ground truth about future work performance.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One discrepancy within a Scoring Run or calibration exercise.
working_meaning.statement: An Adjudication is a separately attributable resolution of a declared rating disagreement under a pinned rule, preserving all independent ratings, cited evidence and resolution reason.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A pseudonym is not proof that reidentification is impossible.
An export receipt does not grant a new purpose or override withdrawal.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One approved research extract and delivery.
working_meaning.statement: A Research Export is a purpose-filtered, pseudonymized and versioned dataset delivery with exact protocol, eligibility snapshot, field set, source lineage, recipient, expiry and revocation record.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A request is not proof that deletion or correction has completed.
A documented exception must not be hidden as a successful deletion.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One participant request under the selected privacy protocol.
working_meaning.statement: A Participant Rights Request is an attributable request for access, correction, research withdrawal or deletion, with verification, affected-record lineage, applicable decision, execution state and response receipt.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: Software defaults cannot select a lawful retention duration.
A schedule is not evidence that deletion ran successfully.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One Challenge deployment and its data classes.
working_meaning.statement: A Retention Schedule is an owner-reviewed, versioned mapping from data class and purpose to trigger, expiry, deletion route and documented exception under the selected jurisdiction.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: An audit event does not itself authorize access.
A log of a requested action is not proof that its downstream work completed.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One protected read, write, export or deletion action.
working_meaning.statement: An Access Audit Event is an append-only record of a staff or service action on a protected resource, with actor, purpose, target, time, outcome and causal job reference while excluding answer text and secrets.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A pseudonym does not make answer data anonymous.
A participant identity does not imply research inclusion or an employment candidate identity.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One person within a Challenge deployment.
working_meaning.statement: A Challenge Participant is one pseudonymous person identity eligible to enter a declared Challenge, linked to contact and reidentification data only through restricted custody.

payload.applicability: Project-scoped candidate Definition record preparation only; semantic owner review and any Lab admission remain separate.

boundaries: A vault is not a research extract or scorer input.
Storing a key separately does not alone prevent reidentification.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One challenge deployment and its authorized identity operations.
working_meaning.statement: An Identity Vault is the restricted mapping between a Challenge Participant's pseudonym and contact or reidentification data, with separate access, retention and deletion controls.

originating_intent: Give each of the 78 local concepts its own reviewable carrier-shaped Definition record while keeping Lab admission separate.
